exposure: Fibroid type (intramural, combination of intramural/subserosal, subserosal)
cohort: 121 pregnant women with fibroids 4 cm or greater in size identified on ultrasonography at the dating scan between January 2002 and December 2012.
finding: Different fibroid characteristics were associated with varying pregnancy outcomes, including preterm delivery, cesarean section rate, postpartum hemorrhage, estimated blood loss, and admissions for fibroid-related pain.
mod_finding: Fibroids in the lower part of the uterus were associated with a higher cesarean section rate compared to fibroids in the body of the uterus (86% vs 40%; P = .01).
